UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and AI workspace preferences owned by the authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display username chosen by the user.

email.description: User email address (private PII, owner-only access).

customInstructions.description: Optional custom instructions applied to chat and code generation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A saved chat conversation belonging to a specific user.

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who owns this chat session.

title.description: AI-generated short topic title for the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message inside a user's chat session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was stored.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and workspace settings, strictly readable and writable only by the owning user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Chat sessions owned by the user, with AI-generated topic titles.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Ordered messages belonging to a user's chat session.
